rules.sentence: Long QT syndrome is often due to congenital defects in cardiac ion channels that affect their opening and closing durations.
Many medications can cause QT prolongation, including anti-arrhythmics such as amiodarone, specific antibiotics such as fluoroquinolones, and antipsychotics.[13]
Changes in this interval can signify pathologies, such as long QT and short QT syndromes.
